response.original_text:
She had been suffering for 12 years.
But when she heard Jesus was passing by, she didn’t wait for the perfect words. She didn’t need to explain everything.
She simply reached for Him.
She believed that even touching the hem of His garment could change everything.
And Jesus said, “Daughter, your faith has healed you.” (Mark 5:34)
Maybe you’re tired. Maybe you’ve been carrying something quietly for a long time.
Keep reaching for Jesus.
You don’t need perfect faith. Just keep reaching for Him.
